brief: How to boost your confidence every day — 6 hard truths.

slots.title: SIX HARD TRUTHS ABOUT DAILY CONFIDENCE
NO ONE WILL SAVE YOU
slots.body: Confidence isn't given. It's built through action, repetition, and owning your choices. Stop waiting for permission.

slots.title: COMPETENCE COMES BEFORE CONFIDENCE
slots.body: You can't affirm your way to self-belief. Real confidence follows proof. Do the work first, then the feeling follows.

slots.title: COMFORT ZONES KILL GROWTH
slots.body: Safety feels good but keeps you small. Growth lives on the other side of awkwardness and uncertainty. Step into it daily.

slots.title: JUDGMENT IS INEVITABLE MOVE ON
slots.body: People will always have opinions about you. The hard truth is that their thoughts are none of your business. Keep going.

slots.title: CONFIDENCE REQUIRES RADICAL SELF HONESTY
slots.body: You can't fix what you refuse to see. Look at your flaws without cruelty, then take responsibility for changing them.

slots.title: CONSISTENCY BEATS INTENSITY EVERY TIME
slots.body: One bold move won't change your life. Small daily actions compound into unshakable self-trust. Show up when it's boring.

slots.headline: START BUILDING CONFIDENCE TODAY
slots.body: Pick one truth and act on it today. Your future self is watching.
